items.title: Godfrey Hirsch Interview, 1987-10-20
items.q: I never heard him play upright. He was playing electric. It might have been Tim Jackson. I don't know but he was good.

ctx.x: I never heard him play upright. He was playing electric. It might have been Tim Jackson. I don't know but he was good. He was here in town. But he plays upright.
